evidence: A report published by CoinTelegraph approximately eight hours before the prediction cutoff indicates that PayPal is rolling out P2P payments and external transfers supporting Bitcoin. limitations: Only one evidence record was available, derived from an unverified free crypto news source rather than authenticated Yahoo reporting.
Macroeconomic factors, broader market sentiment, and order book dynamics outside of this single adoption headline cannot be accounted for.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
